lessons.title: Conversation: Following Up After an Interview

items.en: In my opinion, it went well.
When will they respond to you?
They will respond to me next week.

items.uz: Sizga hozir xavotir olishingiz kerak emas.
items.en: You don't need to worry now.

items.uz: Hatto natija yomon bo'lsa ham, yangi imkoniyat topaman.
items.en: Even if the result is bad, I'll find a new opportunity.
I just need to be patient.
Thank you, it's nice to hear this.
